messages:
Maria G: heads-up — p95 token latency climbing in hosted-usw2-gpu-pool for the last 10m, admission queues at ~92%. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/usw2/gpu/pool-latency :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ajit K: spike or ramp? any tenant hot-spotting?
Maria G: looks sustained. KV cache hit rate dipped ~12%. spike in small-embedding jobs with long seqlen distribution (many 2–3k tokens).
Samir: can we check preemption/eviction churn? also look at GPU util vs queue depth, might be scheduling backlog.
Leila: ops note — we have the proactive latency-hedging config sitting in staging (hedge-window + soft-preempt). want to try a short roll on low-priority tenants and route them to burst-usw3? cheaper than full refill but has cost tradeoffs.
sre-bot: [ALERT] hosted-usw2-gpu-pool p95 > target for 10m. triggered at 2345678860.
Ajit K: quick triage cmd: `curl -s "https://routing.internal/api/pools/usw2/metrics" | jq '.queues|sort_by(.wait_ms)[-5:]'` — can someone run and paste top offenders?
Samir: ran query, top offenders: tenant:search-prod (avg wait 340ms), tenant:embeddings-batch (avg wait 290ms), tenant:chatbot-x (avg wait 220ms). many small batches from embeddings-batch flooding queue.
ops-bot: capacity-predictor: 15% chance of pool saturation in next 60m if current trend continues. option: spin ephemeral 2x A30 nodes in us-west-3 (est +$2.8/hr), or enable soft-eviction/hedging.
Leila: plan — enable hedging for low-priority route (tenant tag: best-effort) for 15m, reduce their admctrl weight to 0.75, and shift routing fallback to burst-usw3 for >200ms queue times. I'll flip feature-flag.
Maria G: please add a short-lived dashboard panel of admission-weight vs p95 so we can see impact.
Ajit K: flipping flag in infra-config: `PATCH /config/pool/usw2 -d '{"hedging":"best-effort:15m","weights":{"best-effort":0.75}}'`
Leila: done. enabled hedging for best-effort at 2345678908.
Samir: monitoring — p95 trending down after ~90s; queue depth dropped ~18%. will report in 5m.
Maria G: thanks — also opened ticked #INC-4212 to track if embeddings-batch needs batching limits.
Leila: also added a temporary cost alert to warn if burst-usw3 usage > 1 node for >10m.
ops-bot: cost-safety: burst-usw3 nodes spun: 0 (no action taken).
Maria G: update after 10m: p95 back to baseline, KV hit marginally recovered. hedging seems effective for this pattern. :thumbsup:
Ajit K: follow-ups: 1) rate-limit config for embeddings-batch, 2) longer-term: model-quantization suggestion to reduce seqlen for small-embedding workload.
Leila: noted, will schedule a quick postmortem and add to runbook: proactive-hedging play.
Maria G: great work, thanks everyone.
